codeHost.title: Remote host
codeHost.devNote: This source runs on this server. To run it on a remote host, build its image, run the image there, and connect the host.
codeHost.builtNote: This source runs on the remote host at {{host}}.
codeHost.builtCodeNote: This source runs its built image on a remote host. Its code is changed in dev mode: switch back to dev under Remote host.
codeHost.destinationHelp: A container registry of this organization, set under Admin, Container registries, or a download to load with docker load.
codeHost.building: Building the {{arch}} image. This can take a few minutes.
codeHost.dockerLoad: Load it on the remote host with docker load -i <file>.
codeHost.composeHelp: Set PROVISA_HOST_PORT to a free port on the host before starting it. The container listens on 7443 inside. On its first start it prints a pairing code in its log.
codeHost.hostHelp: Where Provisa reaches the container: its host name or address. On a shared Docker network or in Kubernetes, the container or Service name.
codeHost.portHelp: The host port the container's 7443 is published on: PROVISA_HOST_PORT in the compose snippet. With nothing published (a shared network or Kubernetes), 7443.
codeHost.pairingHelp: The line the container printed on its first start, after "pairing code:". It is used once.
codeHost.notAnswering: The remote host does not answer: {{error}}
codeHost.otherCode: The remote host runs other code ({{reported}}) than this source is pinned to ({{pinned}}). Its reads are refused until you review the code and re-pin.
